displayName: Canonical COBOL payroll/reporting service · Java Spring 3 + JUnit 5 + AssertJ
description: Reference COBOL → Java Spring 3 scaffold for the openmainframeproject cobol-programming-course demo programs (DEPTPAY / EMPPAY / CBL0106). Generates a buildable Maven module with a claim-mapped service skeleton, request + result records, JPA-style repository boundary, and JUnit 5 fixtures cited to the signed COBOL spec.

matches.fallback: Default cobol→java-spring archetype while the per-paragraph matcher (#3c.next) is in development.

platformReadiness: Schema (cobol) + prompts (cobol/java-spring/extract.v0.1) + this archetype ship in-tree. Engineer flow: ingest a COBOL corpus, extract claims via the cobol→java-spring prompt, SME signs, scaffold lands as Demo.Payroll Maven module with claim-mapped JUnit fixtures. Phase 5.5 wires the maven-sidecar to drive mvn compile + mvn test against the generated package.
